    Twisted traces when two is invertible #

    Appendix A ("Assume two is invertible and put v = y - z = x + 2y"): when m + m = 0 forces m = 0 on the target, a twisted trace kills every element r with 2^n r in the ideal of relations. It therefore factors through the quotient R₂ of the free ring by the 2-saturation of the relations, where 2 r = 0 implies r = 0.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
